name: VO2max test and retest, moderate runner, 4 weeks (running mode)
goal: A baseline VO2max test (economy stages, ramp to exhaustion, verification bout on another day), two easy weeks, then the same test again to see the change.
audience: Runners who can run 8 km/h for 30 minutes and want a VO2max measurement with a mask (for example a VO2 Master) on the W1. Needs the handrail raised (running mode) and the staged running-speed validation (run-7 to run-12) done first. Check incline and belt speed first (docs/treadmill/VO2MAX.md); the incline calibration is provisional.

sessions.note: Fit the mask first; this also checks the mask and the log alignment.

sessions.off: Rest. No hard running before the ramp.

sessions.note: Rested, fed 2-3 hours before, same time of day for the retest. A spotter stands by.
The verification bout: a constant load a little above the ramp end point.

sessions.off: Rest or an easy outdoor run.

weeks.note: Keep the last two days before the retest easy.

sessions.note: Same stages as week 1; compare VO2 at each speed.
